mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESTAURANT ( restaurant_id, room_id, name, source, address, lat, lng, added_by, created_at ) VALUES ( SEQ_RESTAURANT.NEXTVAL, (SELECT room_id FROM ROOM WHERE room_uuid = #{roomUuid}), #{name}, 'MANUAL', #{address}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{participantId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT r.restaurant_id, r.name, r.source, r.address, r.lat, r.lng, r.added_by, r.created_at FROM RESTAURANT r JOIN ROOM rm ON rm.room_id = r.room_id WHERE rm.room_uuid = #{roomUuid} ORDER BY r.created_at
